mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, parent_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, version, deleted_at FROM app.department WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, code, name, parent_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, version, deleted_at FROM app.department WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.department(code, name, parent_id, created_by, updated_by) VALUES(#{code}, #{name}, #{parentId}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE app.department SET name = #{name}, parent_id = #{parentId}, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND version = #{version}
